```{r}
#| label: setup

# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)

# Data and resources
source(here::here("data/clean-data/constants.R")) # Constants
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sed_2022_geometries.Rda")) # SED Summer Hill boundary
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sa1_maps_sh_geometries.Rda")) # SA1 Summer Hill boundaries
load(here::here("data/clean-data/maps/sa2_maps_sh_geometries.Rda")) # SA2 Summer Hill boundaries
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_age5.Rda")) # Age by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tallyroom/nsw_la_2023.Rda")) # Election results by polling place
load(here::here("data/clean-data/digital-atlas/da_housing_sa1.Rda")) # Polling place locations
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_language.Rda")) # Language by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_birthplace.Rda")) # Birthplace by SA1
load(here::here("data/clean-data/tablebuilder/tb_religion.Rda")) # Birthplace by SA1

# Merge the SA1 geometries to the tablebuilder data
sa1_maps_sh_age <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_age5[, c("sa1_code_2021", "Total", "Y15to24", "Y60plus")],
            by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_housing <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(da_housing_sa1[, c("sa1_code_2021", "owned_percent", "mortgage_percent", "rent_percent")],
            by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_language <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_language, by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_birthplace <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_birthplace, by = "sa1_code_2021")

sa1_maps_sh_religion <- sa1_maps_sh |>
  left_join(tb_religion, by = "sa1_code_2021")

# Define the colour palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "Greens",
  domain = sa1_maps_sh$Total
)

```


## Population density

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-pop
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill population density by SA1. Source: ABS Census 2021"
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    fillColor = ~pal(Total),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
      "<em>", sa1_code_2021, "</em><br>",
      "Pop: ", scales::comma(Total))
    )  |>
  addPolylines(data = sa2_maps_sh, color = '#6F83A9', weight = 2)  |>
  addPolylines(data = sed_2022, color = "black", weight = 5) |> 
  addMarkers(data = stations, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, label = ~station, icon = train_icon) 
```






## Age distribution


### Age and sex profile

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-age-sex
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill Age and Sex Distribution. Source: ABS Census 2021"
tb_age5 |> 
  left_join(sa1_maps_sh[c("sa1_code_2021", "sa2_code_2021", "sa2_name_2021")], 
            by = "sa1_code_2021") |> 
  summarise(
    m_0_19years = sum(m_0_19years),
    m_20_39years = sum(m_20_39years),
    m_40_59years = sum(m_40_59years),
    m_60_79years = sum(m_60_79years),
    m_80plusyears = sum(m_80plusyears),
    f_0_19years = sum(f_0_19years),
    f_20_39years = sum(f_20_39years),
    f_40_59years = sum(f_40_59years),
    f_60_79years = sum(f_60_79years),
    f_80plusyears = sum(f_80plusyears)
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = 'count') |> 
  mutate(
    sex = ifelse(substr(group,1,1) == "m", "male", "female"),
    group = factor(substr(group, 3, 13),
                   levels = c('0_19years', '20_39years', '40_59years', '60_79years', '80plusyears'),
                   labels = c('0-19 years', '20-39 years', '40-59 years', '60-79 years', '80+ years'))
    ) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = group, values_from = count, names_from = sex) |> 
  mutate(
    labm = ifelse(male > 5000, paste0(scales::comma(male), " (", round(100 * male / (sum(male) + sum(female)) ),  "%)"), ''),
    labf = ifelse(female > 5000, paste0(scales::comma(female), " (", round(100 * female / (sum(male) + sum(female)) ),  "%)"), '')) |> 
    ggplot(aes(y = group)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = male), fill = 'lightblue', color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_col(aes(x = -female), fill = 'lightpink', color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = male, label = labm),
            size = 8 / .pt, hjust = 1, color = 'grey40', nudge_x = -100) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -female, label = labf),
            size = 8 / .pt, hjust = 0, color = 'grey40', nudge_x = 100) +
  scale_y_discrete(NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL,
                     limits = c(-15000, 15000), 
                     breaks = seq(-15000, 15000, 5000), 
                     labels = function(x) comma(abs(x)))

```



### Age and sex profile by SA2

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-age-sex-sa2
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill Age and Sex Distribution by SA2. Source: ABS Census 2021"

tb_age5 |> 
  left_join(sa1_maps_sh[c("sa1_code_2021", "sa2_code_2021", "sa2_name_2021")], 
            by = "sa1_code_2021") |> 
  group_by(sa2_name_2021) |> 
  summarise(
    m_0_19years = sum(m_0_19years),
    m_20_39years = sum(m_20_39years),
    m_40_59years = sum(m_40_59years),
    m_60_79years = sum(m_60_79years),
    m_80plusyears = sum(m_80plusyears),
    f_0_19years = sum(f_0_19years),
    f_20_39years = sum(f_20_39years),
    f_40_59years = sum(f_40_59years),
    f_60_79years = sum(f_60_79years),
    f_80plusyears = sum(f_80plusyears)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  pivot_longer(-sa2_name_2021, names_to = "group", values_to = 'count') |> 
  mutate(
    sex = ifelse(substr(group,1,1) == "m", "male", "female"),
    group = factor(substr(group, 3, 13),
                   levels = c('0_19years', '20_39years', '40_59years', '60_79years', '80plusyears'),
                   labels = c('0-19 years', '20-39 years', '40-59 years', '60-79 years', '80+ years'))
    ) |>  
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c('sa2_name_2021', 'group'), values_from = count, names_from = sex) |> 
  mutate(
    labm = ifelse(male > 500, scales::comma(male), ''),
    labf = ifelse(female > 500, scales::comma(female), '')) |> 
    ggplot(aes(y = group)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = male), fill = 'lightblue', color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_col(aes(x = -female), fill = 'lightpink', color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = male, label = labm),
            size = 8 / .pt, hjust = 1, color = 'grey40', nudge_x = -100) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -female, label = labf),
            size = 8 / .pt, hjust = 0, color = 'grey40', nudge_x = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~sa2_name_2021, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_discrete(NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL,
                     limits = c(-3000, 3000), 
                     breaks = seq(-3000, 3000, 1000), 
                     labels = function(x) comma(abs(x)))

```



### Younger voters 15 - 24 years

```{r}
#| label: fig-sh-age15-24
#| fig-cap: "Summer Hill Age distribution: younger voters 15 to 24 years. Source: ABS Census 2021"
leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |> 
    addPolygons(
    data = sa1_maps_sh_age,
    fillColor = ~pal(Y15to24),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", sa2_name_2021, "</b><hr>",
      "SA1: <em>", sa1_code_2021, "</em><br>",
      "Pop 15-24y: ", scales::comma(Y15to24))
    )  |>
  addPolylines(data = sa2_maps_sh, color = '#6F83A9', weight = 2)  |>
  addPolylines(data = sed_2022, color = "black", weight = 5) |> 
  addMarkers(data = stations, lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, label = ~station, icon = train_icon) 
```


::: {.aside}

Because we are restricted to Census 2021 data, the 15 to 24 year olds are 19 - 29 years in 2026. IN 2021, there were 3,330 people aged 15-19 years and over 2,000 of these will be eligible to vote in their first state election in 2027.  

:::
